taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: Azure Container Registry repository-scoped publication and consumption
controls.source_trace: Resolve allowed content/metadata actions at a repository and trace whether lower-trust publication affects an approved workload image.
controls.implementation_branch: Distinguish registry-wide roles, repository permissions and the actual permission mode supported by this registry. A token scope map governs named repository actions, not downstream deployment trust. Determine whether a lower-trust producer can replace the digest consumed by a protected release; being able to push its own independent repository is an expected control.
controls.operational_method: Read roleAssignmentMode before interpreting role names. In RBAC Registry+ABAC Repository Permissions mode, legacy AcrPull/AcrPush/AcrDelete grants are not honored; inspect repository reader/writer/contributor roles and their ABAC conditions, and catalog-list/control-plane rights separately. A data role without an ABAC condition may apply registry-wide. Compare the same pull/push operation on an intended repository and a nonmatching repository using supplied policy/trace or an isolated policy fixture.
controls.controlled_verification: Use an owned registry/local fixture and synthetic image metadata; compare authorized repository action with a different repository or release tag.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Registry login or pull from an intentionally shared repository is not cross-repository write or deployment compromise.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Constrain repository actions and pin deployment provenance/digest, then verify authorized producer and reader workflows.
